focus: Skilled-side overlay engine contract (manifest, status, protectedPaths, repin roots)
noveltyJustification: All 8 findings were new to this lineage; the engine contract had not been read before iteration 1, and one finding directly contradicts the dispatch brief.

keyFindings.text: A missing `.skilled-overlays.json` does not itself fail status: `resolveOverlayDir` silently falls back to the literal folder `skilled-overlays`, and the run only dies one step later when `loadManifest` throws `no overlay manifest at …/overlay-manifest.json`, which the CLI catch turns into exit 2 with the message on stderr. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/overlay-engine.cjs:375] [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/overlay-engine.cjs:425] [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/overlay-engine.cjs:3340]

The protected-path refusal is a whole-run throw, not a per-entry block: `assertSafeToPlan` raises for any `token`-named path it meets inside a directory or skill-root walk, and `analyze` raises again for a protected destination or source, so one `*token*` file aborts every other overlay's report with exit 2 and no `MISS` line naming the entry. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/overlay-engine.cjs:1688] [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/overlay-engine.cjs:1801]

That throw is inconsistent with the engine's own reporting model: classified states in `BLOCKING_STATES` are printed per overlay as `blocked <overlay>: <state> <path>` and collected into the report, so an overlay-level refusal already has a shape the protected-path throw bypasses. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/overlay-engine.cjs:58] [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/overlay-engine.cjs:2884]

`DEFAULT_RUNTIME_FOLDERS` lists `.claude`, `.codex`, `.cursor`, `.devin`, `.opencode`, `.pi` and omits `.dsh`, while the doctor's own runtime-mirror contract treats `.dsh` as a first-class surface with `dsh_skills`, `dsh_prompts` and `dsh_agents` sync scripts, so a re-pin of a tree that ships `.dsh` mirrors copies stale mirrors unless the manifest overrides `repin.runtimeFolders`. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/overlay-engine.cjs:74] [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/tests/doctor-runtime-mirrors-contract.test.cjs:46]

A re-pin copies only `.skilled/**` plus the runtime folders and deletes only paths under `.skilled` and the runtime folders, so a root file such as `AGENTS.md` or `REPO RULES.md` is neither carried forward nor removed when upstream changes it; the vendored root copy silently drifts from the new pin. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/overlay-engine.cjs:2531] [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/overlay-engine.cjs:2539]

`repin.exclude` already exists, is validated as a list of relative paths, and is covered by a test that keeps a real `.opencode/scripts` folder where upstream ships a link, so the brief's "no repin.exclude for .opencode/scripts" is a Barter manifest gap rather than a missing engine feature. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/overlay-engine.cjs:2503] [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/tests/overlay-engine-repin.test.cjs:456]

Post-write regeneration is declared entirely by the manifest: `layoutLinks` recreate links, `regenerate` runs `argv` steps and snapshots their `outputs`, and `verifyGenerated` re-runs read-only checks with `fresh-true` or `zero-changed` expectations, so dsh skill links, runtime mirrors, hook registrations, trigger index and advisor graph can all be re-pinned today only if a manifest names them; the engine ships no default step set. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/overlay-engine.cjs:1424] [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/overlay-engine.cjs:1516] [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/overlay-engine.cjs:1531]

A staged re-pin deliberately drops the regenerate and verify blocks before writing the copy, so a clean `RESULT: STAGED` report is not evidence that the live post-repin tree regenerated or verified. [SOURCE: .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/overlay-engine.cjs:2914]
